comments.body:
Hi man, Quant positions are extremely competitive in Switzerland. Moreover, the Investment Banking / Quants branch of UBS is mostly centered around London currently. And with CS and UBS merger there is almost zero demand because they try to staff from CS.

In all honesty, being adjacent the field I would try to go to the states if possible. I have multiple friends that did a MSc at ETH and now ended up in Software Engineering or Data Analyst type of positions…
comments.author: lemonhead94
